name: typescript-basic
description: Small TypeScript fixture where a pricing helper is called directly by two files and imported transitively by two more.

mutations.name: add-required-currency-argument
mutations.description: Adds a required second parameter to calculateSubtotal. Direct callers that still pass one argument should fail typecheck.
mutations.replace: export function calculateSubtotal(items: CartItem[], currency: string): number { void currency;

mutations.name: rename-exported-function
mutations.description: Renames the exported target function. Direct importers should fail because calculateSubtotal is no longer exported.
